name: markdown-transform-e2e
description: End-to-end tests that load the UMD browser bundles into a real headless Chromium and exercise the public API.

scripts.build:bundles: npm run -w @accordproject/markdown-html webpack && npm run -w @accordproject/markdown-template webpack && npm run -w @accordproject/markdown-transform webpack
scripts.pretest: npm run build:bundles && npx --yes playwright install chromium
